data.one_liner: Package for super-fast offline reverse geocoding using a custom data file.
data.what_it_does: It performs offline reverse geocoding by searching through a provided data file using a k-d tree. Once initialized, location searches take about 4-5 milliseconds.
use_when: You need fast reverse geocoding without an internet connection
You want to supply your own custom place data file such as GeoNames or USGS data
avoid_when: You require an out-of-the-box global reverse geocoding database without managing your own data file
You need online-only features or real-time updates from a live mapping server
strengths: Supports running searches in an isolate
Works entirely offline using custom delimited files
weaknesses: Requires you to supply and format your own place data file
Does not include pre-bundled global maps or default offline databases
data.setup_notes: No native permissions or build_runner required. You only need to provide a data file asset or string to initialize the library.

alternatives.name: geocoding
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer online-based geocoding and reverse geocoding without managing raw offline data files.
